license_note: Mixed field-level terms: the producer catalog identifies CC BY 4.0 and ODbL 1.0 attributes. Retain the catalog, source attribution and original-source notices; do not describe the entire attribute table as uniformly CC BY 4.0.
limitations: Polygons and pour points are distinct producer layers, each retained separately.
Attribute codes, scaling, spatial extent and aggregation rules must be interpreted using the versioned field-semantics supplement and producer documentation.
The metadata supplement is separate from the unchanged immutable r2 analytical package.

Live GEE counts and 522 sampled IDs per layer match. Both layers have numeric differences including integral GEE GDP values; the polygon layer also has three narrow source spikes absent spatially from GEE. Strict parity fails. No exhaustive GEE or independent scientific-accuracy claim.

snapshot_collection.description: Two analytic GeoParquet assets from the pinned LakeATLAS v1.0 producer File Geodatabase: the complete polygon layer and separate pour-point layer. The deterministic spatially ordered representations preserve producer OBJECTID, Hylak_id and all decoded source fields, nulls, and WKB; WGS84 bbox fields support spatial filtering. No geometries are repaired or simplified. Attribute years vary by source and do not represent a 2026 observation.
